verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents creating, acknowledging and resolving incidents directly from Slack, and Slack alert messages that include an acknowledge action. It also offers an AI SRE you can tag in Slack or call from MS Teams, plus post-mortems built from the incident timeline and Slack. However, nothing shows automatic incident channels, role assignment (e.g. incident commander) or structured status updates. Teams support is evidenced only for notifications and the AI SRE, not for declaring or running incidents. Missing for 10: auto-created incident channels, incident role assignment, automated update cadence, Teams-based incident declaration, independent corroboration.
